title: The Fastest Way to Remember a Word? See It #shorts
description:
The fastest way to remember a word? See it.
• Gloomy: a grey, rainy Monday
• Cosy: a blanket and hot tea by the fire
• Crowded: a train at rush hour
• Spotless: a kitchen after a deep clean
• Noisy: a classroom when the teacher leaves

Which picture will you remember tomorrow? Tell me in the comments.

Find more words on anotherwordfor.net
